items.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.description:
School Conjuration (healing); Level adept 2, alchemist 2, bard 2, cleric 2, druid 3, hunter 3, inquisitor 2, investigator 2, occultist 2, oracle 2, paladin 3, ranger 3, shaman 2, skald 2, spiritualist 2, warpriest 2, witch 2; Domain Healing 2
    

  
  Casting Time 1 Standard

  Components V, S

  

  
  Range Personal

  
  Targets creature touched

  
  Duration Instantaneous

  

This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Leather armor is made up of multiple overlapping pieces of leather, boiled to increase their natural toughness and then deliberately stitched together. Although not as sturdy as metal armor, the flexibility it allows wearers makes it among the most widely used types of armor.

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description:
This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.
ConstructionRequirements Forge Ring, shield of faith, caster must be of a level at least three times higher than the bonus of the ring; Cost 1,000 gp
